system.description: Vital Bracelet (VB) Digital Monster evolution, as used by the first-generation DIM cards (Vital Bracelet Digital Monster 2021, Digivice -V- 2021, Vital Hero 2022). The evolution data lives on the DIM card, so the same card has the same requirements on all three devices.

requirementTypes.vitalValues: Vital Values (VV), earned from heart rate and steps. On the early original VB this is 1 VV per 50 steps ("miles"), checked every 3 min; on the Digivice -V-, Vital Hero and later original firmware it is 4. Happy mood doubles gains and upset/injured halves them. Battle wins add VV and losses subtract it. Not wearing the device while the Digimon is awake costs VV (-50 per 5 min on the original). Per-stage cap: Child 2,500, Adult 5,000, Perfect 7,500, Ultimate 9,999. A route requirement is a minimum at the moment of the check; fallback routes use a maximum.
requirementTypes.trophies: Earned from missions. Normal Mission: a daily goal (steps, VV, battles or wins), 1 trophy. Hard Missions: short exercise sets (squats, crunches, punching, sprinting), 1-2 trophies each, 4 per day. Special Missions: from the VB Lab app, 3 trophies; the app shut down 2023-03-13. On the Vital Bracelet BE, trophies are renamed PP.
requirementTypes.battles: Number of battles fought (wins plus losses) in the current stage. Battles come from NFC contact, the VS DIM against another bracelet, the end of an Adventure Mission, or VB Arena battles. VB Arena battles count per the Humulos manual; VB Lab tour battles did not count per Wikimon. Only Stage III and above can battle.
requirementTypes.winRatio: Wins / battles in the current stage, as a minimum percentage.
requirementTypes.time: A per-stage evolution timer: Baby I 1 h, Baby II 3 h, Child 16 h, Adult 24 h, Perfect 24 h. The Ultimate-to-Omegamon special Jogress is checked every 3 h. On some other DIMs an Ultimate can evolve on stats after 24 h. Time in backup or with the device off does not count. On the original VB, time asleep does not count either; on the Digivice -V- and Vital Hero it does. The timer starts at the previous evolution.
requirementTypes.adventureStage15: Each DIM has 15 Adventure Mission areas (walk a number of steps, then fight). Clearing area 15 unlocks one hidden evolution on that DIM (marked "Stage 15 cleared"). The device remembers the clear per DIM, so later Digimon from the same card keep it.
requirementTypes.jogress: At the Adult->Perfect and Perfect->Ultimate checks, the device looks at the backup slot. If the backup Digimon is the same stage, has a different attribute, and its attribute is one that route lists, the active Digimon jogresses into that route's target instead. Stats are not checked, the partner only has to be in backup when the timer ends, and the partner stays unchanged. Jogress takes priority over normal evolution. Special Jogress: War Greymon (Agumon DIM) + Metal Garurumon (Gabumon DIM) -> Omegamon, checked every 3 h, needs no Adventure clear, and the card of each partner matters. Attribute Jogress does not work on the Vital Bracelet BE.
requirementTypes.careMistakes: None. The VB has no feeding, cleaning or care-mistake system. A Digimon dies after 4 injuries in one day (an injury comes from losing a battle while upset) or after 24 h of not wearing the device (sleep and backup time excluded). Too many back-to-back losses can kill it.
requirementTypes.withOrWithout: Wikimon wording, not a device concept. "(with or without X)" on a Wikimon Evolves list means at least one listed source (often another game) has the route without a partner. For one VB DIM the route can still be Jogress-only (see appLockMismatches).

decision.perStageStats: All stats (VV, trophies, battles, win ratio) reset at each evolution, except Stage I->II and II->III. Requirements are therefore per stage. The companion app shows lifetime totals, so it should not be used to judge requirements.
whenTimerEnds: 1. If a valid Jogress partner is in backup (same stage, different attribute, listed for a route), Jogress happens.

2. Otherwise the stat routes are checked. If several are met, the route listed first in the DIM data wins. Empirically that is the one with the highest VV requirement, then the highest win ratio requirement (Humulos FAQ). A Gamerch commenter on the Agumon card reports the same: with both War Greymon and Blitz Greymon met, they got War Greymon (5,000 VV beats 4,500 VV).
3. Child -> Adult always has a fallback route (e.g. Agumon -> Coelamon when trophies <= 2 OR VV <= 499), so a Child always evolves ("guaranteed to evolve into Stage IV unless you kill it first").
4. Adult/Perfect with nothing met: no evolution. The timer resets and the check repeats after the same stage time. Holding the button to cancel an evolution also resets the timer.
decision.cardDifferences: All four cards are first-wave DIMs (2021-2022) that share one template. Child->Adult has 4 tiers, the lowest being a fallback. Each Adult has 3 stat routes plus 2 Jogress routes (3 on Guilmon EX2). Perfect->Ultimate thresholds are per target (5,000 VV / 20 trophies / 20 battles / 70%; 4,500 VV / 15 / 15 / 70%; 4,500 VV / 10 / 15 / 50%), plus one Stage 15 unlock (7,000 VV / 20 / 25 / 70%). Guilmon EX2 uses different Child tiers (10T/1,300VV/8B, 8T/900VV/5B, 5T/600VV/3B, fallback <=4T or <=599VV or <=2B). Ancient Warriors uses 8 trophies (not 5) for V-dramon. Other DIMs differ: Dinosaur Roar / Wolf Howl (US) require 1,200 VV for Koromon->Agumon and reach Omegamon by stats (30T/8,500VV/30B/70%, 24 h). GP cards have "choose one" lists mixing stats and Jogress. Vital Bracelet BE memories use a different system (PP, no attribute Jogress). Wikimon calls the Agumon/Gabumon cards "Agumon EX DIM"/"Gabumon EX DIM" because they were sold in "Dim Card Set EX: Digimon Adventure:". The app's Guilmon card is the 17-species Dim Card EX2 (2022), not the 8-species Dim Card GP Guilmon (2021); Wikimon's merged Evolves lists sometimes show the GP routes.

disagreementsAndCaveats: Metal Greymon -> War Greymon needs 10+ trophies, while the other parents of War Greymon need 20+. Humulos, Gamerch and the JP sheet (as a footnote) all say so, so it looks like a real per-edge exception in the DIM data, not a typo. The device stores requirements per edge, not per target.

Sagittarimon -> Magnamon (Ancient Warriors): Gamerch says 70%+ win ratio; Humulos and the JP sheet say 50%+. Gamerch itself gives 50% for the other two Magnamon parents, so 70% is probably a Gamerch typo. Neither species is in the app.
Wikimon prose says Vital Values "exceeding N"; Humulos ("N+") and the JP sources ("N以上" = N or more) mean >= N. I encode it as min N.

Wikimon Evolves-list notes for Growmon -> Megalo Growmon ("Vaccine, Data or Free Adult") and Megalo Growmon -> Dukemon ("Vaccine Perfect") match the Guilmon GP card in Humulos. On Guilmon EX2 both are stat routes.

Nine app edges have lockedAsMerge=false although the sources say they are Jogress-only on that DIM. The cause: the Wikimon line reads "(with or without ...)" because it merges other games (Digimon Story: Time Stranger, Pendulum, card games, DWNO), and build_data.py treats "with or without" as optional. See appMismatch in each card.

Order among several met stat routes follows the DIM data order. "Highest VV, then highest win ratio" is an observed pattern (Humulos FAQ), not a documented rule. No Bandai primary source with numeric requirements was found; Bandai's product pages and manual do not give per-route numbers.
